articles.title: Bitcoin slides to 3-month low of $65,000 as analyst flags fourth capitulation wave
articles.snippet: "They are now selling at the very price they wish they had taken advantage of three months ago," wrote James Check.

articles.title: Bitcoin plunges to $68,000 as Anthropic IPO frenzy adds to market jitters
articles.snippet: Analysts see no direct link between Nvidia and bitcoin's decline, pointing instead to investor capital headed into Anthropic as well as a broader risk-off move.

articles.title: Kalshi ends Donald Trump Jr.’s advisory contract over 1789 Capital’s Polymarket investment
articles.snippet: Trump Jr. joined Kalshi as a strategic adviser in January 2025, helping the prediction market expand its customer base and strengthen its market presence.

articles.title: Microsoft confirms global outage resolved, rules out cyberattack
articles.snippet: Microsoft attributed the outage to a network capacity upgrade issue, confirming that the disruption was unrelated to cyberattacks or AI agents.

articles.title: Kalshi ends Donald Trump Jr. advisory role over Polymarket investment: Reuters
articles.snippet: The prediction market operator said the decision was mutual and followed 1789 Capital’s investment in rival Polymarket, denying political considerations.
